name: jleape-github-io-private
description: Build + encrypt scripts for the stealth apps served from this site.

scripts.encrypt:gambiarra: staticrypt private/_src/apps/gambiarra/dist/index.html -p "$STATICRYPT_PW" --short --remember 30 -d apps/gambiarra --template-title Stealth --template-instructions "Enter password to continue." --template-button Unlock
scripts.publish:gambiarra: npm run install:gambiarra && npm run build:gambiarra && npm run encrypt:gambiarra
